sources.title: Haryana Government, Human Resources Department, Notification No. 28/67/2008-1HR-I, Chandigarh, 16 December 2025 (posted as 'Regarding declaration of holidays for claender year 2026', https://csharyana.gov.in/regarding-declaration-of-holidays-for-claender-year-2026/)
sources.said: It is hereby notified that the following holidays enumerated in the Schedule-I, II & III shall be observed as public Holidays in all Public Offices under the Haryana Government during the Calendar Year 2026. SCHEDULE-I (Gazetted Holidays): All Sundays (52); All Saturdays (52); Sir Chottu Ram Jayanti/Basant Panchmi 23 January Friday; Republic Day 26 January Monday; Holi 4 March Wednesday; Shaheedi Diwas/Martyrdom day of Bhagat Singh/Rajguru & Sukhdev 23 March Monday; Ram Navmi 26 March Thursday; Mahavir Jayanti 31 March Tuesday; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti/Vaisakhi 14 April Tuesday; Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) 27 May Wednesday; Maharana Pratap Jayanti 17 June Wednesday; Sant Kabir Jayanti 29 June Monday; Shaheed Udham Singh Martyrdom day 31 July Friday; Raksha Bandhan 28 August Friday; Janmashtami 4 September Friday; Shaheed Divas/Haryana War Heroes's Martyrdom day 23 September Wednesday; Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti 2 October Friday; Dussehra 20 October Tuesday; Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 26 October Monday; Vishvakarma day 9 November Monday; Guru Nanak Dev Jayanti 24 November Tuesday; Christmas day 25 December Friday. Note: the following festivals and occasions which fall on closed day have been excluded: Guru Ravidas Jayanti 1 February Sunday; Maha Shivratri 15 February Sunday; Id-ul-Fitr 21 March Saturday; Parshuram Jayanti/Akshay Tirtiya 19 April Sunday; Independence Day 15 August Saturday; Maharaja Agrasen Jayanti 11 October Sunday; Haryana Day 1 November Sunday; Diwali 8 November Sunday. SCHEDULE-III (Holidays under Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881) ... (Except Judicial Courts): All Sundays; Republic Day 26 January; Holi 4 March; Id-ul-Fitr 21 March; Annual closing of Bank Account 1 April; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti 14 April; Buddha Purnima 1 May; Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) 27 May; Maharana Pratap Jayanti 17 June; Independence Day 15 August; Janmashtami 4 September; Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti 2 October; Dussehra 20 October; Maharishi Valmiki jayanti 26 October; Vishvakarma Day 9 November; Guru Nanak Dev Jayanti 24 November; Christmas Day 25 December. (Scanned; read page by page. A substituted copy 'bearing same number and date', https://csharyana.gov.in/WriteReadData/Instructions/Human-Resources-I/15689.pdf, created 23 Dec 2025, keeps Schedules I and III as above and changes only Schedule II, restricted holidays.) SCHEDULE-III (Holidays under Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881): All Sundays; Republic Day 26 January; Holi 4 March; Id-ul-Fitr 21 March; Annual closing of Bank Account (1st April) 1 April; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti 14 April; Buddha Purnima 1 May; Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) 27 May; Maharana Pratap Jayanti 17 June; Independence Day 15 August; Janmashtami 4 September; Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti 2 October; Dussehra 20 October; Maharishi Valmiki jayanti 26 October; Vishvakarma Day 9 November; Guru Nanak Dev Jayanti 24 November; Christmas Day 25 December.

sources.title: Haryana Government, Human Resources Department, Notification No. 28/67/2008-1HR-I, Chandigarh, 25 May 2026 (posted as 'Request to change the Public Holiday for Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) 2026')
sources.said: It is hereby notified that Thursday, the 28th May, 2026 shall be observed as Gazetted Holiday in the Departments/Boards/Corporations, Educational and other Institutions under the Haryana Government on account of festival 'Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid)' instead of Wednesday, the 27th May, 2026 already notified vide Notification No 28/67/2008-1HR-I dated 16.12.2025. It is also notified that the Gazetted Holiday of 'Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid)' 28th May, 2026 shall also be observed within the meaning of Section 25 of Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.

sources.title: Andaman and Nicobar Gazette, Extraordinary, No. 95, Sri Vijaya Puram, 12 November 2025: A&N Administration Secretariat, Notification No. 90/2025/F.No.M-13/18/2022-GA-Section-Sectt (List of Public Holidays for 2026), with No. 96 (Notification No. 91/2025, restricted holidays)
sources.said: Under the Explanation of Section 25 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 ... the Lieutenant Governor of A & N Islands has been pleased to declare the following days to be Public Holidays in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands during Calendar Year, 2026: 1 Republic Day January 26 Monday; 2 Holi March 04 Wednesday; 3 Id-ul-Fitr* March 21 Saturday; 4 Ram Navami March 26 Thursday; 5 Good Friday April 03 Friday; 6 Buddha Purnima May 01 Friday; 7 Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid)* May 27 Wednesday; 8 Muharram* June 26 Friday; 9 Independence Day August 15 Saturday; 10 Milad-un-Nabi or Id-e-Milad (Birthday of Prophet Mohammad)* August 26 Wednesday; 11 Onam or Thiru Onam day August 26 Wednesday; 12 Mahatma Gandhi's Birthday October 02 Friday; 13 Dussehra October 20 Tuesday; 14 Diwali (Deepavali) November 08 Sunday; 15 Guru Nanak's Birthday November 24 Tuesday; 16 Christmas Day December 25 Friday. * Subject to change depending on the appearance of the Moon.

sources.title: A&N Administration, Signal No. 22-35/2012-GA dated 26.05.2026 (Assistant Secretary (GA))
sources.said: Holiday on account of Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) notified on 27 May 2026 vide Admn Notification No.90/2025/F.No.M-13/18/2022-GA-Section dt 12.11.2025, subject to moon sighting, has now been shifted to 28 May 2026 in view of celebration of Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) in A&N Islands on 28.05.2026. Accordingly, 28 May 2026 shall be observed as holiday in place of 27 May 2026 for all Govt offices, autonomous bodies, PSUs and educational institutions under A&N Administration.

sources.title: Andaman Sheekha, holiday on 14 April 2026 (Sri Vijaya Puram, April 13)
sources.said: In pursuance of Office Memorandum No. 12/4/2020-JCA dated 09.04.2026 (DoPT), the Hon'ble Lt. Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands has declared Tuesday, the 14th April, 2026, as a holiday on account of the birthday of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar in all Government Offices, institutions, public sector undertakings including industrial establishments in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
